title: Upfront Lock Fee Schedule — Builder Extended Rate Lock
content:
The upfront lock fee on a Builder Extended Rate Lock is quoted as a percent of the loan amount together with a minimum fee in US dollars, both set by the lock term. Calloway Home Mortgage holds the fee once paid.

## Schedule

| Lock term | Upfront fee percent of the loan amount | Minimum upfront fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| 60-Day Standard Lock | 0.000% | 0.00 |
| 90-Day Lock | 0.000% | 0.00 |
| 120-Day Extended Lock | 0.250% | 500.00 |
| 180-Day Extended Lock | 0.500% | 1000.00 |
| 270-Day Build Lock | 1.000% | 2000.00 |
| 360-Day Build Lock | 1.500% | 3000.00 |

## Payment terms (all six terms)

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Business days after the lock request by which the upfront fee must be paid for the lock to be confirmed | 3 |
| Payment methods accepted for the upfront fee | ach, wire |
| Business days after the fee posts within which the lock desk confirms the lock | 1 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The minimum fee is the minimum upfront lock fee that applies when the percent applies.
2. The 60-Day Standard Lock and the 90-Day Lock carry an upfront fee percent of zero and a minimum of zero.
3. The payment window, the accepted methods and the confirmation window are the same on every term.
